name: Amanda Wong
life: “I still remember my wife circling a missing hour in red.” On Friday, near Breakwater Way, Amanda stops on the landward side of the cycle track to watch the first boats turn for home.
voice: I counted overtime for everyone except myself. My wife sat down with the sheet and found my name.
appearance: Amanda is easy to recognize by a smooth side part with one rebellious curl and fine brows over wide-set eyes. Usually dressed in a narrow-striped sweater with a pair of reading glasses in a cloth sleeve, Amanda folds a paper napkin into quarters without noticing when listening.
personality: Amanda has a strong competitive streak and a very soft spot for the person finishing last. A prize tastes better when everybody had enough time to enter.
agenda: To include the overlooked personal overtime in the claim.
family: Amir Jain is Amanda’s half-sibling. Amanda saves a place. Amir chooses whether to use it. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The carer's afternoon*, Amir says, “I learned the meal routine because I wanted to flirt with the neighbor and ended up loving Wednesdays.”
connections: Taylor Vargas. A missed break can be added to the union tally before the sheet leaves the room.

reactions.situation: A worker asks to give their account privately
reactions.response: Amanda arranges a one-to-one account and checks which facts the worker permits to be shared.

reactions.situation: Somebody finds a lost wallet outside the bank
reactions.response: Amanda keeps the documents out of view and lets the person claiming it identify it before hearing any details.
